name: Prediqte
tagline: Prediqte is a multi-platform lead generation tool designed for B2B SaaS founders
description: Prediqte is a multi-platform lead generation tool designed for B2B SaaS founders. You enter your website URL, the tool analyzes your product and ICP, then scans Reddit, HackerNews & more to find people actively asking for solutions like yours, whether they're seeking recommendations, complaining about competitors, or looking for alternatives.
